value: Ahluwalia, R.K., Wang, X., Papadias, D.D. and Star, A.G. (2023). Performance and Total Cost of Ownership of a Fuel Cell Hybrid Mining Truck. Energies 16(1), 286. https://doi.org/10.3390/en16010286

Argonne model of a 3500 hp-equivalent ultraclass haul truck (330 t payload) on a 883 s duty cycle: diesel genset versus two hydrogen fuel-cell hybrid architectures (FCH and FCBC). Loaded: powertrain efficiencies, fuel per cycle (gal diesel, kg H2) with derived per-tonne-payload and per-hour values, FCS/battery sizes and lifetimes, component costs for status and ultimate technology (Table 2), derived overhaul and stack replacement costs. Not loaded: whole-truck capex (chassis omitted by the study), TCO bar values (Fig. 9, read only in text), battery degradation and thermal-management detail. Locator: printed journal page (PDF page = printed page; the PDF text layer is duplicated, line-by-line, so figures were taken from the clean sentences). Traps: no price year (2023 used); per-tonne values are per payload tonne per haul cycle on the Table 1 route (distance per cycle not extracted, so no t-km); costs are powertrain-only; FCS cost 323 USD/kWe assumes 10,000 units per year; FCBC ultimate costs equal FCH ultimate and are listed once; headline efficiency advantage differs between abstract (81-88 %), results (77 % and 54 %) and conclusion (54-87 %).
